figurative_meaning_en: ordinary people or any common person
example_sentences_in_bangla: যে সে লোকের কথা শুনলে কাজ হবে না।
এটা যে সে বিষয় নয়, গুরুত্বপূর্ণ।
example_sentences_in_english: You can't listen to every Tom, Dick, and Harry.
This isn't a matter for just anybody; it's important.
note: Refers to unspecified or average individuals in colloquial Bengali usage.
